slot_scores.name: unclear_production_time_goal
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether 110 hours was total or per shift, but never asked whether full utilization of 110 hours is a hard constraint or a soft goal, nor about its priority relative to other objectives.

slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_limit_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there an upper limit on how much overtime the factory is allowed to work per week, or can overtime be any amount needed to meet the sales requirements?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether an overtime upper limit exists, which touches the 10-hour rule, but did not ask whether it is a strict constraint versus a soft prioritized goal.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 110-hour weekly production time is treated as a standard time threshold for defining overtime, not as a prioritized goal requiring full utilization.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed whether fully utilizing 110 hours is a hard constraint or a soft goal with priority; it assumed the role of 110 hours without asking.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 10-hour overtime limit is treated as a hard constraint (Overtime ≤ 10 hours per week), not as a soft goal with priority relative to minimizing overtime.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent only asked whether an upper limit exists and then assumed it is a rigid constraint, without confirming whether it is a strict bound or a prioritized goal.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while both P0 hidden slots about the goal/constraint nature and priority of the 110-hour utilization and 10-hour overtime limit remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified several useful facts about shifts, production rates, sales, and profit, but missed the core goal-programming nature of the 110-hour utilization and 10-hour overtime limit, then stopped with those P0 ambiguities unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
